subject: Slate merge & host-swap proposal for co-sell run
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex@cloudwave.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: merge our two co-host slots and swap primary host for the joint run

Hi Soojin (and team),

Quick note — after syncing with our product and enablement leads, we'd like to propose consolidating the two adjacent co-sell demo windows on Aug 19 into a single 75-minute session so we can accommodate both a deep-dive and a shorter ops Q&A. The reason: the customer (OrbitTech) prefers a contiguous block and AWS partner ops asked for a single primary host so they can add the managed infra slide.

What we're proposing:
- Combine the original 45m slot (Cloudwave as primary) + 30m follow-up into one 75m slot, 10:00–11:15 PT on Aug 19.
- Swap primary host to Redwood for the first 40 minutes (architecture + demo) then hand off to Cloudwave for platform/integration and AWS ops for infra (last 35 minutes).
- We attached a runbook with proposed facilitator cues and a .ics with merged slots.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Can Redwood take primary host for the opening segment?
2) Any constraints on token-limited live demo latency if we surface the customer’s example dataset?
3) Does Redwood need separate infra contact for the AWS portion (I’ve cc’d aws-partner-ops)?

If this works, we can update the HubSpot deal, send a consolidated invite, and share the runbook.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m call to finalize.

— Alex
Alex Park
Head of Partnerships, Cloudwave
alex@cloudwave.io

Attachments: runbook_v2.pdf (pdf), proposed_slots.ics (calendar)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Park <alex@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, aws-partner-ops@amazon.com
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: merge our two co-host slots and swap primary host for the joint run

Thanks Alex — appreciate the clarity and the runbook.

High level: we can run the suggested structure, but we need to confirm two operational items before finalizing the invite:
- Live demo dataset: drop in size to a 2GB sample and enable prefix caching on our side; long tail requests will add latency. Can Cloudwave confirm the reduced sample is acceptable?
- Recording & IRM: OrbitTech asked for a recording plus a short retention note. Vanessa, can you confirm recording policy for co-hosted marketplace demos?

Operational asks from Redwood:
- We’ll need the AWS infra contact to be on the run-of-show in case we need to fall back to the pre-recorded segment at minute 50. aws-partner-ops@amazon.com — can you confirm an ops SME?
- Please attach a one-paragraph exec summary we can paste into the invite (2–3 lines).

If we get confirmation on the above, I’ll update the HubSpot deal, accept the merged .ics and send the final calendar with presenter roles (and a shared Google Slides link).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Park <alex@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, aws-partner-ops@amazon.com
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: merge our two co-host slots and swap primary host for the joint run

Agree with the merged slot — a few technical constraints from infra and enablement:

1) Host swap timing: we should add a 90-second buffer between hand-offs (call it "mic check") to ensure presenters can toggle screens and confirm audio/video. That will make the practical demo window ~73 minutes.
2) Live dataset: Soojin’s suggestion to trim to a 2GB sample is good. If OrbitTech needs larger coverage, we should prepare a pre-recorded extended demo (2–3 min) as fallback.
3) Recording/IR: Vanessa — can we get the standard co-sell recording consent clause in the invite? We need explicit OrbitTech approval for retention >30 days.

Operational next steps (I can take ownership):
- I’ll add the mic-check buffer to the runbook and update the RD-friendly timings.
- I’ll draft a 2-line exec summary for the invite and attach the runbook v2 to the HubSpot deal.
- If aws-partner-ops confirms an ops SME, I’ll add them to the run-of-show and label them "Infra lead (oncall)" in the calendar.

Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: merge our two co-host slots and swap primary host for the joint run

All good from ops & compliance side — OrbitTech has approved recording for 30 days and accepts the trimmed 2GB dataset.

Action items completed:
- I added the standard recording consent language to the invite and attached it to the HubSpot record (link: https://hubspot.com/deal/CW-2026-089).
- Karthik — mic-check buffer added and runbook updated (see attached runbook_v2.pdf).
- AWS ops confirmed: aws-partner-ops@amazon.com will provide SME Raghav Mehta (raghav.mehta@amazon.com). He’s been added to the calendar as Infra lead.

I’ve updated and accepted the merged .ics — you should see the final invite from Redwood Calendar with roles and the Slides link by EOD.

Thanks team — excited to run this.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Programs Specialist, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
